About.title: About KickPick
About.intro: KickPick compares shoe prices from local and international brands in one place, so you don't have to open dozens of tabs to find the best price.
About.faq1A: No. KickPick only compares prices and directs you to the official store or marketplace to complete your purchase.
About.faq2Q: How does KickPick get its price data?
About.faq2A: Data is collected automatically from official brand sites and marketplaces through a scheduled system, updated regularly.
About.faq3Q: Does KickPick earn commission from purchase clicks?
About.faq3A: Yes, KickPick earns affiliate commission from some listed stores. See the Affiliate Disclosure page for full details.
About.faq4Q: Why can prices on KickPick differ from the original store?
About.faq4A: Prices update automatically on a schedule, so there can be a short delay compared to real-time price changes at the original store.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: This policy explains what data KickPick collects and how it's used, in line with Indonesia's Personal Data Protection Law (UU PDP).
Privacy.section1Body: We collect your email, name, size preferences, search history, and saved wishlist when you use a registered account.
Privacy.section2Body: Data is used to personalize recommendations, send restock/price-drop alerts, and improve size conversion accuracy.
Privacy.section3Body: Passwords are stored hashed, login sessions use tokens that expire automatically, and all API connections run over HTTPS.
Privacy.section4Body: You can access, update, or delete your data at any time from the Profile page.

Disclosure.title: Affiliate Disclosure
Disclosure.body1: KickPick is a price comparison platform that earns part of its revenue from affiliate commissions. When you click Buy and complete a purchase at the destination store, KickPick may receive a commission from that store or its affiliate network, at no extra cost to you.
Disclosure.body2: This commission does not influence the order or selection of stores shown in the price comparison. The cheapest store is always marked objectively based on actual price data, not on the size of the affiliate commission.
